facts.applicability_notes: Official publication states the maximum vessel discharge (unloading) rate in liquid LNG volume units. '12.500' is the publication's thousands notation for 12500; the exact literal text is retained in original_value_text. No conversion to gas volume, energy or an average rate is made. Not a guaranteed average discharge rate, booked right or current availability.
facts.quotation: Max. Vessel discharge rate is 12.500 m3/h of LNG

facts.applicability_notes: Official publication states the terminal minimum delivery rate in normal-gas volume units. '139.000' is the publication's thousands notation for 139000; the exact literal text is retained in original_value_text. The same bullet says additional services may allow lower flow rates. Not a maximum sendout, MWh/h value, unloading limit, booked right or current availability.
facts.quotation: Min delivery rate of the terminal is 139.000 m3(n)/h

facts.applicability_notes: Official FAQ answer describes insulation-limited evaporation as approximately 0.07% of tank capacity per day. Tank capacity is the denominator; this is not a cargo-energy percentage, physical loss, retained fuel, invoice deduction or recoverable/irrecoverable energy quantity. No conversion is made.
facts.original_value_text: approximately 0.07% of the tank capacity per day
facts.quotation: approximately 0.07% of the tank capacity per day

facts.applicability_notes: Official infrastructure page describes jetty unloading at a maximum liquid-LNG flow rate for vessels. The same sentence's 8,800 m3 per hour reloading limit and the page's sendout capability are separate and are not converted or substituted. No vessel-size, average-rate, booked-right or current-availability inference.
facts.quotation: maximum flow rate of 14,000 m³ per hour

facts.applicability_notes: Equipment subsection of the terminal-characteristics tab states SCV regasification capability of 645 GWh/d. This is separate from the later circa 654 GWh/d primary-capacity statement; neither is averaged, overwritten or treated as current available capacity. No mcm/d or bcf/d conversion is used.

Primary-market subsection of the capacities tab states circa 654 GWh/d regasification capacity for contracted phases. This is separate from the earlier 645 GWh/d equipment specification; neither is averaged, overwritten or treated as current available capacity. The publication's 'circa' uncertainty is retained.

Descriptive vessel-discharge duration in the jetty section: the process can take up to 24 hours. Not a guaranteed slot duration, contractual turnaround, constant unloading rate or universally applicable vessel operation. No conversion to days or capacity is made.
facts.quotation: discharge process which can take up to 24 hours
